description: General Transit Feed Specification Weblinks is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Public Transit", published or maintained by Federal Transit Administration. As of Report Year (RY) 2023, FTA requires that reporters with fixed route modes create and maintain a public domain general transit feed specification (GTFS) dataset that reflects their fixed route service. This specification allows for the mapping and other geospatial data visualization and analyses of key transit elements such as stops, routes, and trips. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Public Transit". It has 21 columns, among them Certification Flag, Weblink, Weblink Justification, Agency ID, NTD ID, Modified Date. The portal shows 2026-09-04 as the last data update. Attribution given: Federal Transit Administration. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
